      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff",
      "informal_name": "Coefficient Correspondence under Algebra Equivalence for Multivariate Polynomials with Option Variables",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) (m : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),\n  MvPolynomial.coeff d (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).coeff m) = MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.optionElim m d) p",
      "informal_description": "For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over $ \\text{Option}\\, \\sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any natural number $ m $ and finite support function $ d : \\sigma \\to₀ \\mathbb{N} $, the coefficient of $ d $ in the $ m $-th coefficient of the polynomial obtained via the algebra equivalence $ \\text{optionEquivLeft} $ is equal to the coefficient of the monomial $ \\text{optionElim}(m, d) $ in $ p $. Here, $ \\text{optionElim}(m, d) $ denotes the monomial in $ \\text{Option}\\, \\sigma $ that maps $ \\text{none} $ to $ m $ and $ \\text{some}\\, s $ to $ d(s) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_apply",
      "informal_name": "Application of Algebra Equivalence for Optional Variables in Multivariate Polynomials",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),\n  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) a =\n    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim Polynomial.X fun s => Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X s)) a",
      "informal_description": "The algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over $\\text{Option } \\sigma$ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients over $\\sigma$ is defined by evaluating each variable in $\\text{Option } \\sigma$ as either the indeterminate of the outer polynomial ring (for the $\\text{none}$ case) or as the constant polynomial with coefficient corresponding to the variable in $\\sigma$ (for the $\\text{some } s$ case).",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none",
      "informal_name": "Coefficient correspondence in algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over Option σ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),\n  MvPolynomial.coeff n.some (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) f).coeff (n none)) = MvPolynomial.coeff n f",
      "informal_description": "For any finite support function $ n : \\text{Option } \\sigma \\to₀ \\mathbb{N} $ and polynomial $ f \\in R[\\text{Option } \\sigma] $, the coefficient of the monomial corresponding to $ n $ restricted to $ \\sigma $ in the polynomial obtained by evaluating the algebra equivalence at the variable corresponding to 'none' equals the coefficient of $ n $ in $ f $. Formally, $ \\text{coeff}_{n.\\text{some}}(\\text{Polynomial.coeff}(\\text{optionEquivLeft}(f), n(\\text{none}))) = \\text{coeff}_n(f) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.optionEquivRight_apply",
      "informal_name": "Algebra Equivalence: $ R[\\text{Option } S] \\cong R[X][S] $",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),\n  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivRight R S₁) a =\n    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C Polynomial.X) MvPolynomial.X) a",
      "informal_description": "For any commutative semiring $ R $ and type $ S $, there exists an algebra equivalence between the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\\text{Option } S] $ and the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[X][S] $. This equivalence is constructed by interpreting the 'none' variable as the indeterminate $ X $ in $ R[X] $, while mapping 'some $ i $' variables to the corresponding variables in $ S $. The equivalence preserves addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication by $ R $, establishing a bijective correspondence between these two algebraic structures.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_X_some",
      "informal_name": "Algebra Equivalence Between Multivariate Polynomials Over Option σ and Polynomials in One Variable with Multivariate Coefficients",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (x : S₁),\n  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) (MvPolynomial.X (some x)) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X x)",
      "informal_description": "There exists an algebra equivalence between the ring of multivariate polynomials with variables indexed by $\\text{Option } \\sigma$ (i.e., $\\sigma$ extended with an additional element $\\text{none}$) and coefficients in a commutative semiring $R$, and the polynomial ring in one variable whose coefficients are multivariate polynomials over $R$ with variables indexed by $\\sigma$. This equivalence is constructed by mapping variables corresponding to $\\text{none}$ to the indeterminate of the outer polynomial ring and variables corresponding to $\\text{some } s$ to coefficients in the inner multivariate polynomial ring, with the inverse given by substituting renamed variables.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Coefficient Correspondence under Algebra Equivalence for Multivariate Polynomials with Option Variables
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) (m : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).coeff m) = MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.optionElim m d) p
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over $ \text{Option}\, \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any natural number $ m $ and finite support function $ d : \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N} $, the coefficient of $ d $ in the $ m $-th coefficient of the polynomial obtained via the algebra equivalence $ \text{optionEquivLeft} $ is equal to the coefficient of the monomial $ \text{optionElim}(m, d) $ in $ p $. Here, $ \text{optionElim}(m, d) $ denotes the monomial in $ \text{Option}\, \sigma $ that maps $ \text{none} $ to $ m $ and $ \text{some}\, s $ to $ d(s) $.

items.informal_name: Application of Algebra Equivalence for Optional Variables in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) a =
    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim Polynomial.X fun s => Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X s)) a
items.informal_description: The algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over $\text{Option } \sigma$ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients over $\sigma$ is defined by evaluating each variable in $\text{Option } \sigma$ as either the indeterminate of the outer polynomial ring (for the $\text{none}$ case) or as the constant polynomial with coefficient corresponding to the variable in $\sigma$ (for the $\text{some } s$ case).

items.informal_name: Coefficient correspondence in algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over Option σ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n.some (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) f).coeff (n none)) = MvPolynomial.coeff n f
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ n : \text{Option } \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N} $ and polynomial $ f \in R[\text{Option } \sigma] $, the coefficient of the monomial corresponding to $ n $ restricted to $ \sigma $ in the polynomial obtained by evaluating the algebra equivalence at the variable corresponding to 'none' equals the coefficient of $ n $ in $ f $. Formally, $ \text{coeff}_{n.\text{some}}(\text{Polynomial.coeff}(\text{optionEquivLeft}(f), n(\text{none}))) = \text{coeff}_n(f) $.

items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivRight R S₁) a =
    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C Polynomial.X) MvPolynomial.X) a
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $ and type $ S $, there exists an algebra equivalence between the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\text{Option } S] $ and the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[X][S] $. This equivalence is constructed by interpreting the 'none' variable as the indeterminate $ X $ in $ R[X] $, while mapping 'some $ i $' variables to the corresponding variables in $ S $. The equivalence preserves addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication by $ R $, establishing a bijective correspondence between these two algebraic structures.

items.informal_name: Algebra Equivalence Between Multivariate Polynomials Over Option σ and Polynomials in One Variable with Multivariate Coefficients
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (x : S₁),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) (MvPolynomial.X (some x)) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X x)
items.informal_description: There exists an algebra equivalence between the ring of multivariate polynomials with variables indexed by $\text{Option } \sigma$ (i.e., $\sigma$ extended with an additional element $\text{none}$) and coefficients in a commutative semiring $R$, and the polynomial ring in one variable whose coefficients are multivariate polynomials over $R$ with variables indexed by $\sigma$. This equivalence is constructed by mapping variables corresponding to $\text{none}$ to the indeterminate of the outer polynomial ring and variables corresponding to $\text{some } s$ to coefficients in the inner multivariate polynomial ring, with the inverse given by substituting renamed variables.
